Refactor this project's user store. Rename the type store.UserRecord to store.Account. Replace store.LoadUser(id string) (*UserRecord, error) with store.LoadAccount(ctx context.Context, id string) (*Account, error), which returns ctx.Err() when the context is already done and otherwise behaves exactly as LoadUser did. Update every caller and every test; nothing may still use the old names. Behaviour must not change otherwise.
